remediation_steps.title: Validate Access and Cluster Context
remediation_steps.description: Ensure the operator has the required ProdOperations role and that kubectl is pointed at the production cluster in us‑east‑1.
verification: AWS identity ARN includes ProdOperations role

remediation_steps.title: Assess Disk Utilization on Affected Node
remediation_steps.description: Confirm that /var/log on node-prod-4 is indeed above the critical threshold and capture the top offending files.
commands: kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep node-prod-4
verification: List of large log files identified for cleanup

remediation_steps.title: Enforce Write Freeze and Promote Read‑Replica
remediation_steps.description: Stop new writes to the primary storage, promote the existing read‑replica to primary to maintain service continuity, and verify replication health.
commands: kubectl get pods -n storage -l app=payment-processor -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.phase}'

remediation_steps.title: Drain and Reboot Affected Node
remediation_steps.description: Gracefully evict pods from node-prod-4, clean up log files, reboot the node, and allow pods to reschedule onto healthy nodes.
commands: ssh -i ~/.ssh/prod_key ec2-user@node-prod-4 "sudo rm -rf /var/log/*.log && sudo systemctl restart rsyslog"
verification: kubectl get nodes shows node-prod-4 Ready after reboot

remediation_steps.title: Post‑Remediation Health Audit
remediation_steps.description: Run synthetic health checks for the payment‑processor service and confirm that error logs have returned to baseline.
commands: kubectl logs -n payment-processor -l app=payment-processor --since=10m | grep ERR_STORAGE_EXHAUSTION || true
verification: Health endpoint returns HTTP 200 with status OK
No storage exhaustion errors appear in logs for the last 10 minutes

rollback_plan.overall_strategy: If any step fails or service degradation persists, revert the node to its pre‑drain state, demote the promoted replica, and restore the original deployment image tag.

steps.description: Cancel node drain and re‑attach original pods
Demote the promoted replica back to read‑only and re‑enable writes on the original primary
Rollback deployment to previous container image tag
verification: kubectl rollout status deployment/payment-processor shows successful rollback
Pods run the prior image tag

prerequisite_checks: Write‑freeze policy approved by change management
Backup of /var/log and database snapshots taken
